intelligence.human_view: Two glows, one defect: a tab that shouts its colour instead of wearing it. "It just looks ridiculous" is the whole diagnosis — the fix is not a different glow, it is no glow: clean, in its own colour, simple. The tabs are the bigger settlement: four words that map a citizen's worlds — mine, ours, this one, all of them — and "Public" becomes "Collective" because the public feed IS the collective feed; the word was wrong, not the feed. The behaviours list is the page as he experiences it, section by section, each with one obvious behaviour — and the last line is the honest one: membership still doesn't work for him, and it is named, not hidden.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your feed has four magic doors: YOUR door, the EVERYBODY door, THIS WORLD door, and ALL YOUR WORLDS door! And the "everybody" door used to be called "public" — but "collective" is the right name, because it's everybody together! The red tab was glowing way too bright — like a torch in your eyes. Now it's just a nice clean red. And every part of the page does one simple thing when you tap it — just like he listed!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — your page has four little tabs now, like four rooms: your own room, the big shared room where everybody gathers, the room you're in right now, and a hallway to all your rooms. The shared room used to be called "public", but "collective" is the kinder, truer word — it's everybody together. And that red tab was glowing far too bright, dear — like a lamp with no shade. Now it just sits clean in its own colour. Simple is best.
intelligence.naya_view: Personal / Collective / World / Worlds — yours, ours, this one, all of them. "Public feed" is Collective now. Both glows toned down to clean. Every section one obvious behaviour. Membership named blocked, never faked.
